title: chat.php error response
description: Body for every non-200 outcome of chat.php and for a 200 that carries a request error. 401 not authenticated; 403 CSRF failed or ACL denied ('You are not authorized to view this chart'); 400 no patient selected, unknown action, or question missing; 500 internal error (logged with stack trace under the same correlation id). Never contains an exception message or any chart data.

correlation_id.description: Present on every error that reached the controller; quote it when reporting a problem.
